name: Dealing with the smuggler
notes: Seen alongside the island smuggler, buying from her or fencing to her (plan 06 §14.6 decision 1). Plan 06 §2.2 has no row for it; it's heated like smuggling.

name: Dealing with a fence
notes: Selling stolen goods or contraband in a port fence's back room (plan 05 §6.2; Phase 6 piece E). Nobody sees it indoors; it reaches the law only when the fence informs, at Wanted tier 2+ on Phase 5's receiver odds.

name: Smuggling
notes: Caught with contraband: a merchant who finds it out, or the cutter's hold search (piece C). Confiscation is the economy's (plan 05 §6).

name: Selling hot goods
notes: A merchant found a stolen lot out (HotGoodsDetected). Hot goods stay a dev command until Phase 6's theft.

name: Stealing contract cargo
notes: Always traced to you. The company's agents up and down the lake hear of it, so its news spreads (Phase 5's stand-in for the crime that spreads; Phase 6 makes sinking that crime). The Standing hit is the contracts' own (plan 05 §5.2).

name: Trespass
notes: Caught sneaking on the docks at night.

name: Burglary
notes: A warehouse, or cargo from a moored ship.

name: Piracy
notes: Forcing a surrender and looting at sea (Phase 6 piece F). Her crew reports it at their next port, later if set adrift or disabled; ships in sight while you loot are witnesses.

name: Firing on a ship
notes: Any shot fired on or across a merchant ship, a warning shot included: once a ship, an encounter. Gunfire is heard well beyond sight.

name: Sinking a ship
notes: Sinking or scuttling a ship. The crime that spreads (plan 06 §3.4): its news reaches the neighboring regions.

name: Murder
notes: Any death aboard a ship you fired on, boarded or sank: one crime an encounter, however many die (the papers count them).

name: Firing on the law
notes: Firing on the revenue cutter or the chartered tug. Puts the region at Most Wanted at once, and the Morrill shoots to sink (plan 07 §14.6).
